faq.q1: How do I receive my order after payment?

faq.q2: Can I get a refund if I face a problem?
faq.a2: Yes, we guarantee the quality of all our products. If you face any issue, open a support ticket and we'll resolve it or refund you.
faq.a3: Yes, all details are listed in the features section above. For more, contact support.
faq.a4: Of course, you can buy the same product again anytime at the same price or using a discount coupon.
faq.a5: We accept bank transfer, credit cards, and cryptocurrencies. All payment methods are secure and encrypted.
faq.a6Auto: Delivery is instant and automatic — you'll get your data right after payment is confirmed.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.s1Content: By using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, please do not use the site.
termsPage.s2Content: We provide a service for selling products and services through our online store. Each product's details are shown on its own page and delivered according to the stated delivery method.
termsPage.s3Content: We accept bank transfer, cryptocurrencies, and PayPal. All payments are final after approval and delivery of the product. The buyer must upload payment proof in the case of a bank transfer.
termsPage.s4Content:
We provide a full guarantee in the following cases:
• If the delivered product does not match the description
• If the product is not delivered after 24 hours from payment approval
• If there is a defect in the product upon delivery

Refunds are not accepted in the following cases:
• If the product has already been used
• If the product matches the description and is intact
termsPage.s5Content: Products and services must be used personally and lawfully. Any illegal use, or use that violates others' rights or the terms of manufacturers/providers, is prohibited.
termsPage.s6Content: We are committed to protecting your personal data to the highest security standards. We do not share your data with third parties without your consent. Your order data is protected and accessible only by you.
termsPage.s7Content: We are not responsible for any losses resulting from misuse of the products. We are committed to delivering products as described on the site.
termsPage.s8Content: We reserve the right to amend these terms at any time. Users will be notified of any material changes via email or notifications.
termsPage.refundDesc: We guarantee your full satisfaction. If you face any problem with your order, contact us within 24 hours of delivery and we will work to resolve it or refund you in full.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions
faqPage.notFoundDesc: Get in touch with our support team
faqPage.cat1a1: After payment is confirmed, the product is delivered automatically if delivery is instant. The details appear directly on the order details page in your dashboard. For manual delivery, it's delivered within 1-24 hours.
faqPage.cat1q2: How long does payment review take?
faqPage.cat1a2: Payment proof is reviewed within 1-6 hours during business hours. After approval the product is delivered instantly.
faqPage.cat1a3: An order can be canceled before payment review. After the product is delivered, it cannot be canceled.
faqPage.cat2a1: We accept bank transfer, cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, USDT), and PayPal.
faqPage.cat2q2: What do I do after a bank transfer?
faqPage.cat2a2: After completing the transfer, upload a photo of the payment receipt on the order page. It will be reviewed and confirmed within hours.
faqPage.cat2q3: Are there extra fees on payment?
faqPage.cat2a3: There are no extra fees. The amount shown on the site is exactly what you pay.
faqPage.cat3a1: Yes, all our products are 100% original and quality-guaranteed.
faqPage.cat3q2: What do I do if I face a problem with the product?
faqPage.cat3a2: Open a support ticket immediately with your order number. The issue will be resolved or the product replaced within hours.
faqPage.cat3a3: Yes, we make sure to display accurate details for every product. Always check the product details page before buying.
faqPage.cat4a1: Yes, for defective or invalid products a full refund is issued. See the refund policy for details.
faqPage.cat4a2: You can open a support ticket from the dashboard, or contact us via email support@store.com

najd.servicesDesc: At Najd Print we believe every small detail makes a big difference, so we deliver our services with meticulous precision and a passion for creativity.
najd.s1Desc: Professional printing solutions for large runs with consistent quality and accurate colors — ideal for brands seeking luxury and reasonable cost while preserving the finest detail.
najd.s2Desc: Fast, flexible printing suited to urgent projects and small runs, with vivid colors and high quality without complexity — the perfect way to get your work done in record time.
najd.s3Desc: We design and produce all indoor printing works such as signs, stickers, and décor in a way that reinforces your project's identity in its space and delivers a professional visual experience.
najd.s4Desc: Strong outdoor printing solutions that withstand the weather — from banners and billboards to vehicle wraps — with high quality that keeps your message clear everywhere.
najd.servicesCtaTitle: Do you have a special printing project?
najd.servicesCtaDesc: Talk to our printing experts today for a free consultation and a custom quote for your next project.
najd.stickersDesc: Najd stickers are not just adhesive paper — they are your brand's front on every surface. Durable, precise, and with endless options.
najd.st1Text: Features a strong shine that enhances color clarity — ideal for promotional stickers.
najd.st2Text: A luxurious velvety touch with no glare. Gives your logo a classic character.
najd.st3Text: Disappears completely so the design looks printed directly onto the surface.
najd.st4Text: Heavy-duty vinyl stickers resistant to water, sun, and high heat.
najd.smallDesc: You don't need to order thousands to start. We give you big-factory quality in quantities starting from just 50 pieces to test your product in the market with ease.
najd.sq1Desc: Start with 50 or 100 pieces of packaging boxes or paper prints without needing huge budgets.
najd.sq2Desc: We use advanced digital printing techniques that deliver results rivaling offset in color accuracy and detail.
najd.sq3Desc: We know your time is gold, so we deliver small-quantity orders within just 3 to 5 business days.
najd.smallHighlightTitle: Are you a home-business owner or run an online store?
najd.smallHighlightDesc: Get free trial samples of your product before starting the actual order.
najd.whyTitle: The secret of our excellence at Najd Print
najd.whyDesc: We don't just print — we craft a complete visual experience that boosts your brand's value in the market and captures your target audience at first glance.
najd.w1Desc: We use the best global papers and inks to ensure stunning results that last.
najd.w2Desc: We respect your deadlines precisely, with express printing options for same-day delivery.
najd.w3Desc: We own a fleet of the most advanced German and Japanese printing machines in the region.
najd.w4Desc: We offer the perfect balance between top quality and the best well-studied prices.
najd.testimonialText: «Najd Print turned our project idea into reality through exceptional packaging that wowed our customers.»
najd.digitalTitle:
Digital printing
at the speed of light
najd.digitalDesc: We use the world's latest digital printing machines to ensure you receive your order in record time and with the highest possible color accuracy. Ideal for small to medium runs and urgent projects.
najd.ioInDesc: We offer high-resolution indoor printing for posters, roll-ups, and custom wallpaper, with vivid colors that catch the eye up close.
najd.ioOutDesc: Outdoor printing built for banners, unipoles, and large signage, designed to withstand strong sun, wind, and rain so your ad stays bright.
najd.largeCtaTitle: Do you need advertising boards for your project?
najd.largeCtaDesc: We provide measuring, design, and installation services for all kinds of wide-format prints.
najd.sliderFeaturedSubtitle: Discover our latest work in premium printing and packaging
